newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends higher on stock-induced inflow.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends higher on stock-induced inflow.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly higher on Saturday as the domestic stock market rise attracted some foreign funds, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.842 against Friday's T$27.867 close.
Turnover through dealers was a modest US$146.5 million.
The stock market shrugged off recent caution and soared by 1.98 percent on Saturday.
"Some foreign funds were drawn into Taiwan by the stock rise," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
But dealers said the rate would likely resume its recent downtrend next week on the central bank's pledge not to intervene in the market.
Central bank governor Sheu Yuan-dong told a news conference on Saturday that the bank would allow market forces to determine the Taiwan dollar's value.
A T$27.83-87 range was seen for Monday.
